reply.body:
**Scope update — CI registration moves to [#5666](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5666).** [e282fff](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/commit/e282fff2c1e7972c2211d999e5486beacc5a8d5e) syncs the current base and restores its exact benchmark CI configuration, keeping this child limited to OpenFeature changes.

The two Go benchmark functions and the inactive-call guard remain. Their CI registration and performance review are **deferred**, not completed at this head; the earlier registration evidence above applies to its linked commit. We will address that work in the base after folding in this child.

[D017’s inactive-path rule](https://github.com/DataDog/ffe-system-test-data/blob/ec4af07fdae4c0349d5d39fe4135016eee12529c/contracts/experimentation-opt-out/decision-history.md#d017) is unchanged. OpenFeature package and CI-selection tests pass after the base sync; current remote CI is separate.

limits: No fresh Lean, timing, race or operational trace replay. Earlier evidence remains pinned to its original commits; new benchmark CI registration and base performance assessment remain open. No fleet scope change.
